entities.name: Cathedral of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Belgrade
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Cathedral of the Blessed Virgin Mary also called the Catholic Cathedral of Belgrade is since 1988 the cathedral church of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Belgrade. It is located at 75 Hadži Milentijeva Street in the Belgrade's neighborhood of Neimar, in the municipality of Vračar.
